description:
As a customer, I want to change my cart before checking out.

* Increasing the quantity of an item updates that line's total and the cart total.
* Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total.
* Removing the last item shows an empty cart message.
* Cart contents persist after a page refresh.

criteria.text: Increasing the quantity of an item updates that line's total and the cart total.
Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total.
Removing the last item shows an empty cart message.
Cart contents persist after a page refresh.

cases.title: Increasing an item's quantity updates the line total and the cart total
cases.preconditions: A customer is logged in (or browsing as the story allows) with a cart containing <an item that can have its quantity increased>. The cart page is open and the current line total and cart total are noted.
steps: Open the shopping cart page.
Note the quantity, the line total of <the item> and the cart total.
Increase the quantity of <the item> by one.
Observe the line total of <the item> and the cart total.
cases.expected: The line total for that item is updated to reflect the new quantity, and the cart total is updated accordingly.

cases.title: Removing one item of several removes it from the list and updates the total
cases.preconditions: A cart containing <at least two different items>. The cart page is open and the cart total is noted.
steps: Open the shopping cart page.
Note the items listed and the cart total.
Remove <one of the items>.
Observe the item list and the cart total.
cases.expected: The removed item no longer appears in the cart list, the remaining item(s) are still listed, and the cart total is updated.

cases.title: Removing the last item shows an empty cart message
cases.preconditions: A cart containing exactly one item: <any single item>.
steps: Open the shopping cart page.
Remove the only item in the cart.
Observe the cart page.
cases.expected: The item is removed from the list and an empty cart message is shown (exact wording not specified in the story).

cases.title: Cart contents persist after a page refresh
cases.preconditions: A cart containing <at least one item with a known quantity>.
steps: Open the shopping cart page and note the items, quantities and cart total.
Refresh the page in the browser.
Observe the cart contents.
cases.expected: The same items, quantities and cart total are shown after the refresh.

cases.title: Cart changes persist after a page refresh
cases.preconditions: A cart containing <at least two different items, one of which can have its quantity increased>.
steps: Open the shopping cart page.
Increase the quantity of <one item> by one.
Remove <another item>.
Note the item list, quantities and cart total.
Refresh the page in the browser.
Observe the cart contents.
cases.expected: After the refresh the cart still shows the increased quantity, the removed item is still absent, and the item list and cart total match what was shown before the refresh.
